patterns.note: Dramatic two-tone color scheme (red and black) with text color inverting to contrast with the background color of each section.
Prominent use of a classic, elegant serif typeface for large, centered headings, creating a strong editorial and historical feel.
Full-width, distinct vertical sections that fill the viewport, each presenting a new stage of content or narrative.
Sections transition with a full-screen background color change (red to black, black to red) as the user scrolls, accompanied by a text color inversion.
A vertical side navigation bar remains sticky on the right, indicating scroll progress and changing its active state or content as sections transition.

technique_notes: Sections are designed to occupy the full viewport height, with a scroll-triggered transition that swaps the background color and inverts the text color as each new section comes into view. A persistent vertical navigation element on the right side updates its active state to reflect the current section.

design_tokens.type_scale: Dramatic, oversized serif headings (~4-5x body) with generous line height, paired with smaller, legible sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with no visible corner rounding on any elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and deliberate, with significant vertical padding between content blocks and full-viewport sections creating a strong sense of space and rhythm.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dramatic, theatrical presentation, achieved through a stark red and black color palette that inverts with full-screen section transitions, combined with oversized, elegant serif typography. This creates a highly immersive and editorial experience, reminiscent of a digital book or art exhibition.
